title: Scan String Until Lowercase Letter

content.problemStatement: Scan a string that accepts all characters and stops scanning when lower case characters are encountered

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input 'HELLO WORLD How are you' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Scan characters from the string and stop when a lowercase letter ('a'-'z') is encountered.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Iterate through characters of the input string and break immediately upon seeing a lowercase character.

hints: Stop scanning/appending as soon as the condition is met.
learningObjectives: Understand scansets and conditional character reading.
Work with character ranges and ASCII checks.
